subject: Implementor-defined level-2 exception conditions, EC-level-2-IMP (specification and meaning of the specified level-2 exc
notes: A.1 item 100 (optional; documented if provided; Table 13, 14.6.13.1.6). PROVIDED and documented: 20 of Table 13's 22 EC-level-2-IMP names are valid (EC-SCREEN-IMP and EC-VALIDATE-IMP are refused with COBOL1707/1710, the declined modules; EC-CONTINUE-IMP, EC-EXTERNAL-IMP and EC-MCS-IMP are 2023 names, COBOL0878 below), every one FATAL (EcFatality.Imp, IsFatal), and the one implementation raise site is ProgramTable.ParentInstance (EC-PROGRAM-IMP, an internal inconsistency a conforming program cannot reach: the 8.4.6.3 scope rules admit a caller of a contained program only from inside its container's subtree, whose activation keeps the container instantiated). The note's PARTIAL ('not shown whether a conforming program can reach the raise' and 'generate or drift-test the list from the catalog') is closed by the reachability argument now in the 7 row and by EcImplementorNamesDocumentationDriftTests.Item100_NamesExactlyTheCatalogsImplementorDefinedLevel2Names, which holds the row's 22 names equal to the catalog's Imp rows.
